title: TypeDeclarationRecord
description: One record emitted by scripts/audits/type-audit/scan.ts per named TypeScript declaration discovered in in-scope source. The intermediate JSON file is a list of these records; the reviewer consumes it to author docs/type-audit-2026.md.

packageName.description: pnpm workspace name (e.g. @debrief/components). Empty string if outside a workspace.

shapeHash.description: SHA-1 hex of the AST printed form of the declaration

rhsSummary.description: For type aliases, truncated textual summary of the RHS (max 160 chars). Null for interface/enum.

imports.description: Module specifiers imported by the containing file
